_about: Story pictures shown when a quest step starts or is done (src/quests.js qPic). st = only for that starter (the art shows the book pairing).

lines: You dream of crystal trees under a huge red sun that is slowly going out.
The wind moves through the branches like a sad song.
A whisper, soft as leaves: Find the one who listens.
pictures.src: Cutscene 01 - Ch 1 - The Dream of Ystra (Ystra).png

lines: Three capsules glow on Dr. Vashti's brass table: Sporix, Plazmo and Gloopa.
Dr. Vashti: Don't pick with your head. Choose with your heart.
pictures.src: Cutscene 02 - Ch 1 - Choose With Your Heart (Dustara).png

lines: Zib settles on your shoulder, its lights still flashing gold.
One huge eye blinks at you, then at Plazmo.
Zib: Bip!
pictures.src: Cutscene 03 - Ch 2 - Zib Falls From the Sky (Dustara).png

lines: Up at the Observatory, Dr. Vashti watches the old canyon bridge.
She holds a faded photo: four kids in the desert, under the stars.
Dr. Vashti (quietly): After twenty years... Hello again, little one.
pictures.src: Cutscene 04 - Ch 2 - Hello Again, Little One (Dustara) (1).png

lines: Mud everywhere. {starter} is worn out, and you scoop it up gently.
Sola turns away fast. For a second, her eyes look shiny.
pictures.src: Cutscene 05 - Ch 3 - First Rival Battle (Dustara).png

lines: A rock cracks loose from the canyon wall and tumbles at Zib!
A grumpy Cactling leaps in front, curls into a spiky ball and takes the hit. THUNK.
It folds its stubby arms and stares at you. Well? Are you going to ask?
pictures.src: Cutscene 06 - Ch 4 - Cactling Takes the Hit (Dustara).png

lines: Deep in the Sunset Tunnel, the lanterns snuff out one by one.
Two Helix agents in white step out of the dark. A crackling net flies at Zib!
{starter} throws itself in the way. When the dust clears, the agents are gone.
pictures.src: Cutscene 07 - Ch 5 - Ambush in the Sunset Tunnel (Dustara).png

lines: At the tunnel's far end, the Molten Frontier spreads out below you.
Your backpack wriggles. Two round eyes blink up at you from behind your sandwich.
Then whoever it is ducks back down under the socks.
pictures.src: Cutscene 08 - Ch 6 - The Stowaway (Molten Frontier).png

lines: Your bag wriggles, and your little stowaway leaps straight into Kit's arms.
It snuggles in and won't let go. It has made up its mind.
pictures.src: Cutscene 09 - Ch 7 - Sporix Picks Kit (Molten Frontier).png

lines: Dax's giant boulder beast raises one huge foot over {starter}.
You shout NOW! {starter} blasts the cracked ground, and the rock gives way.
The giant topples. THOOOM. Forge Miner Dax just laughs.
pictures.src: Cutscene 10 - Ch 7 - Rumbler Topples (Molten Frontier).png

lines: Up in the Ferrox Relay Tower, the crowd is roaring.
Hank Briggs and his Anvilox, the Iron Wall of Ferrox, are waiting for you.
pictures.src: Cutscene 11 - Ch 9 - The Welder Flame (Ferrox).png

lines: The whole tower cheers. Hank scoops Kit into a hug so big Kit's goggles fly off.
Hank Briggs: THAT'S MY KID!
In your hand, your first Signal Shard hums, warm and blue.
pictures.src: Cutscene 12 - Ch 9 - That's My Kid! (Ferrox).png

lines: Zib floats over the humming Shard, and its big eye begins to glow.
It paints a picture in the air: a deep red world, launching glowing seeds into space.
You whisper: Was that... your home? Zib's lights go very quiet.
pictures.src: Cutscene 13 - Ch 9 - The Red Planet Memory (Ferrox).png

lines: Halfway to Sporeholm, an orange tractor beam locks onto Nana Wren's little ship.
You dive between tumbling chunks of ice, and one snaps the beam clean in half!
The Helix shuttle limps away, a row of empty cages in its open belly.
pictures.src: Cutscene 14 - Ch 10 - Escape Through the Ice (Space).png

lines: In the misty marsh outside Mirefen, a baby Mossback shivers under a fern.
Zib floats close and hums a soft, swaying tune. Hmm-mm-mmm.
The little Mossback opens its eyes, wobbles out... and hums along.
pictures.src: Cutscene 15 - Ch 11 - Zib Sings the Spore Choir Song (Sporeholm).png

lines: Behind a giant mushroom, a Helix grunt flips open a little cage.
Grunt (whispering): Go home. Quickly.
He sees you watching... and puts a finger to his lips.
pictures.src: Cutscene 17 - Ch 13 - Strand Opens the Cage (Sporeholm).png

lines: Dr. Moor's poison has {starter} covered in spots and hanging still...
You shout NOW! Your partner blazes brighter than the Spore Pools and wins the day.
pictures.src: Cutscene 18 - Ch 14 - Plazmet Ignites (Sporeholm).png

pictures.cap: A face in the spore pool
lines: Beside Dr. Moor, a spore pool pulses like a heartbeat.
Zib's eye fills the air with a giant gentle face of leaves and branches, eyes closed.
Zib: ...Bip. It sounds like it misses her.
pictures.src: Cutscene 19 - Ch 14 - The Tree-Mother's Face (Sporeholm).png

lines: You hold up two Signal Shards, and the harbor gate's carvings light up blue.
A shimmering doorway opens onto Thalassa's turquoise seas.
On the dock, the Squid Sailor puffs his bubble pipe as kids ride Bubbub past.
pictures.src: Cutscene 20 - Ch 15 - The Harbor Gate Wakes (Molten Frontier).png

lines: A logbook lies open, stamped with an orange slashed ring: Approved, Admin V.
In the very last cage: a knitted blanket and a note, signed with just one letter. S.
pictures.src: Cutscene 21 - Ch 16 - The Ghost Ship's Cages (Thalassa).png

lines: On the docks, Helix crews are hauling the Harbor Tower's crystal core away.
A woman in a black-and-yellow cape turns. Her eyes are pale as ice.
Admin Vex: Take the core. Leave the children to Hexcoil.
pictures.src: Cutscene 22 - Ch 17 - Admin Vex (Thalassa).png

lines: Knocked flat, Kit's {kit} gets up and plants itself in front of Kit again.
It glows... and grows into {kit2}! Roots burst up and wrap the Hexcoil tight.
pictures.src: Cutscene 23 - Ch 17 - Sporix Becomes Mycelith (Thalassa).png

lines: Captain Marsh's Old Barnaby, a huge barnacled Brineback, rises to breathe.
Your partner has waited for exactly this moment. It streaks in and strikes!
pictures.src: Cutscene 24 - Ch 18 - Old Barnaby Surfaces (Thalassa).png

lines: At the end of the Long Dock, Sola kneels beside her tired partner.
Sola: You got good. That's why I need to do this alone.
pictures.src: Cutscene 25 - Ch 19 - Rook Finally Wins (Molten Frontier).png

lines: The Helix crate bursts open, and hundreds of Glitchbugs pour out!
Signs flash backwards, trains freeze in midair, and a hot dog stand plays opera.
One cheeky Glitchbug zaps the top of your head.
pictures.src: Cutscene 27 - Ch 20 - The Glitchbug Swarm (Neonis).png

lines: On the highest rooftop in Neonis, Kit plugs the last wire into an old broadcast dish.
Through the static comes Sola's tired voice: Is my dad there?
Then a calm, quiet man: Phase Three begins when the eighth tower cracks.
pictures.src: Cutscene 28 - Ch 21 - The Quiet Voice (Neonis).png

lines: Under the strobe lights, DJ Static's giant speaker-beast pounds out the beat.
Your team finds the one gap in the rhythm and strikes. BWAAAMP!
The giant speaker sits down, and the whole crowd goes wild.
pictures.src: Cutscene 29 - Ch 22 - Battle Night at the Voltspire (Neonis).png

lines: Above the fourth Shard, Zib's eye glows brighter than ever before.
Eight towers on eight worlds light up, one by one, in a ring around the sun.
Kit: They're not just towers. They're a seal. In the corner, Dr. Vashti goes quiet.
pictures.src: Cutscene 30 - Ch 22 - The Seal of Eight Towers (Neonis).png

lines: On Glyphos, a crystal in the biggest temple wall begins to glow.
A soft, chiming voice: Little scout. You came back.
Zib's lights flash every color at once.
pictures.src: Cutscene 31 - Ch 23 - Little Scout, You Came Back (Glyphos).png

lines: A sunbeam zigzags from mirror to mirror onto the door crystal.
The Monolets bow low, and the little Chimelet swings out one pure note. Dinnnng.
Every wall hums, and the great doors swing slowly open.
pictures.src: Cutscene 32 - Ch 24 - The Temple Sings (Glyphos).png

lines: Before the tree-mother's mural, Zib pulses sadly in your hands.
You hold it close. You've got a home now. You've got us.
At the end of the hall, a newer mural shows four small figures around a cracked seedpod.
pictures.src: Cutscene 33 - Ch 25 - The Murals of Ystra (Glyphos).png

lines: Before the trial, Dr. Vashti asks you and Kit up to her lab on Neonis.
Dr. Vashti: The four kids in the crater were me, Kael, Orra... and Teo Reyes.
Zib floats up and bumps its saucer gently against her cheek.
pictures.src: Cutscene 34 - Ch 26 - The Crater Four (Neonis).png

lines: Far away, on Helix Station, Sola stands at a window full of stars.
Below the glass floor, rows of caged Alienmon glow in the dark.
Director Thorne: Begin Phase Three. Sola's hands slowly curl into fists.
pictures.src: Cutscene 35 - Ch 26 - Begin Phase Three (Helix Station).png

lines: ...Back on Glyphos, Zib blinks.
For a split second, its big eye reflects something enormous: a giant dark eye, opening.
pictures.src: Cutscene 36 - Ch 26 - The Eye Opens (Space).png
